counterexample: Symmetric difference: K2 xor K2 xor K2 is isomorphic to K2 xor K_{1,3}; K2 and K_{1,3} are connected and prime, so this connected graph of order 8 has the two factorisations {K2,K2,K2} and {K2,K_{1,3}} (proofs/paper/C14.md Theorem 8; explicit isomorphism in EXP-C14-06). In all graphs already C4 = K2 xor K2 = K2 xor 2K1. The other five products show no collision up to order 15 in the stated classes, consistent with Sabidussi-Vizing and Doerfler-Imrich/McKenzie.
statement:
Each of the six commutative associative local products with unit K1 (Cartesian, strong, symmetric
difference, and their complement-duals 221, co-normal, 141) has unique prime factorisation on connected
graphs, or, for the complement-duals, on co-connected graphs.
title: H-C14-3: the six commutative unital associative products factor uniquely on connected (or co-connected) graphs (refuted)
